description: This file defines an internal interface 'IRemoteClientDirectory' within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace. It declares asynchronous methods for updating and retrieving client route information related to remote clients, involving immutable dictionaries and hash sets.

classes.name: IRemoteClientDirectory
classes.description: Internal interface for managing remote client directory operations, including updating client routes and retrieving current client route mappings.

methods.name: OnUpdateClientRoutes
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the client routes based on the provided immutable dictionary of silo addresses and connection info.

methods.name: GetClientRoutes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current client routes, returning an immutable dictionary of silo addresses and corresponding connection info.
